title: Concrete strength with a useless third predictor
intro: The twelve concrete cylinders of item 12.1 again, now with a third column: the laboratory's air temperature (°C) on the day each cylinder was tested. The test machine sits in a climate-controlled room, so there is no reason to expect the room temperature to change the strength. The model is Strength = b₀ + b₁·Curing days + b₂·W/C ratio + b₃·Lab temp. Compare R², adjusted R² and the overall F-test with the two-predictor model of item 12.1 (R² = 0.8316, adjusted R² = 0.7942, F = 22.23).

settings.Name: Concrete, three predictors
settings.Predictors: Curing days, W/C ratio, Lab temp
